contract: A heartbeat inside the session timeout does not expire the member. Silence past the timeout revokes ownership.
Graceful leave revokes that member's partitions immediately.
An offset commit requires the partition to be owned and marked delivered. Cooperative revoke removes an undelivered partition before it can be committed.
A static instance rejoin replaces the old member id and keeps a single owner. Reopen preserves that commit decision.
limits: This is not the Heartbeat or OffsetCommit RPC.
Group offset storage and administration stay on KL11-29.
The journal format is the local PLGLIF01 snapshot.
Not a production qualification and not a fastest-server claim.
